title: Chef Starz (Live Project)
shortDescription: Gourmet Chef Hiring & Recipe Discovery mobile app built with Flutter, GetX, and REST API.
summary: Live culinary & recipe discovery app featuring dynamic API integration, custom UI design, and GetX state management.
description: Developed a live cooking and recipe application with responsive UI and API integration at Sparktech Agency. Integrated REST APIs for dynamic recipe feeds, ingredient calculators, and user profiles. Built responsive, user-friendly UI and maintained a clean, scalable GetX project architecture.
features: Real-time recipe discovery & dynamic REST API consumption
GetX reactive state management & clean route handling
Custom responsive Flutter components for all phone and tablet screen sizes
User profile and chef portfolio showcase screens
